newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products gain, heat oil premiums nudge up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products gain, heat oil premiums nudge up.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer early on Thursday, gas oil lifted by futures and fuel oil pegged higher after steady falls this week, dealers said.
Heating oil barges were up around $2 with buying of the November IPE contract. Offers nudged slightly above IPE screen flat as nervousness over late month deliveries mounted.
High sulphur fuel oil was quiet, but notably reversed weakness from earlier this week. Prices were assessed at $109 fob ARA, about $1 up on Wednesday's close.
